purpose: UX-01 / T04-T05: remove user-controlled contact GET result authority while preserving the existing native POST fallback with a short-lived signed no-PII browser receipt.
ownerSpecification: Прозрачная Цена — инженерное ТЗ быстрого UX-ремонта v2.0, 23.09.2026, sections 3.1-3.2 and UX-01/T04/T05. Bounded contact-result slice only.
coordination: Team Hub #5469 claim 5785980132. Parallel-safe with #5536 market search and Claude Code work order #5537; their paths are excluded.
requiredInvariants: sent=1, sent=true, repeated sent and arbitrary error query parameters never establish success or failure.
Native POST preserves a truthful positive path only through a short-lived server-signed result receipt; token content contains no form fields or PII.
Receipt verification uses a dedicated CONTACT_RESULT_HMAC_SECRET, is time-bounded, constant-time for signatures and scoped to an HttpOnly SameSite contact-page cookie.
Malformed, tampered, expired, future-issued and wrong-key receipts fail closed to the ordinary form.
Existing JSON client success still requires response.ok plus accepted=true, sent=true and delivered=true; no automatic POST retry is added.
No API backend, database, auth, role, tenant, RLS, provider, mail credential, release workflow or production mutation is authorized.
Generated cryptographic inventory paths may change only if the unchanged repository scanner deterministically requires them.
CONTACT_RESULT_HMAC_SECRET is dedicated to this receipt class; auth/cabinet/registration/provider secrets are not reused.
